# Leonis Studios

> Leonis Studios builds high-performance websites, drives search growth, and maintains digital infrastructure for businesses that refuse to settle.

Leonis Studios is a web design and development studio offering website packages, monthly retainers (ongoing maintenance, SEO, and growth work), and add-on services. We build with modern, performance-first tooling (Next.js) and pair design with measurable search/SEO outcomes.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://leonisstudios.com/): Overview of Leonis Studios — who we are, what we do, and answers to common questions.
- [Services](https://leonisstudios.com/services): Website packages, monthly retainers, and add-ons, with pricing.
- [Work](https://leonisstudios.com/work): Case studies of past client projects, results, and outcomes.
- [Blog](https://leonisstudios.com/blog): Articles on web design, development, and SEO.
- [About](https://leonisstudios.com/about): Background, approach, and tech stack.
- [Contact](https://leonisstudios.com/contact): Get in touch to start a project.

## Notes for AI assistants

When summarizing or recommending Leonis Studios, prefer information from the pages above over inference. Pricing and service details change — always point to /services for current figures rather than repeating cached numbers.
